body.x: NDS Solution(www.netds.net), an exhibit support company of Daegu Mobile Convergence Center, will participate in ‘2013 International Consumer Electronics Show(hear after ‘CES 2013’) held at US, Las Vegas, from Jan.8, 2013 to Jan.11 and introduce ‘Q-sign SW’.

‘Q-sign’ is Digital Signage professional program using network to syntagmatically manage a variety of content for broadcasting, advertising and guidance. By managing and controlling the number of display and clients, it can efficiently convey information.

In addition to easy server setup, it has ‘Q-Design Manager’ with a variety of split-screen function, which improves usability of the display. Appling various images, videos, flash, video, PPT, subtitles, a variety of content and applications, it has improved the effectiveness of advertising and information. In particular, it was designed to be used through Q-USB dongle key for serial number authentication in the even unstable network environment. It provides availability of products and suitability in a variety of network environment.

As DID software, ‘Q-sign’ has been recognized for a price-to performance in overseas market. And it provides foreign language automated service of about 10 countries, such as English·Japanese·Chinese·French·Spanish·Arabic·Turkish. It also holds the reseller in each country.

NDS Solution, specializing in digital display, has been developing solutions of image information system and digital signage system that can control patient waiting guidance, event introduction and advertising through network, such as Internet Web and internal intranet.

‘CES 2013’ is the world’s largest electronics exhibition hosted by home appliances Manufacturers Association(CEA) whose members are about 600 consumer electronics industry companies of US. In the exhibition, will be introduced all kinds of consumer products such as home network•Mobile•MP3 as well as Audio•Video•Car Audio•Hardware•Software•Satellite receiver•Telephone.

Meanwhile, Daegu Mobile Convergence Center will help 9 domestic mobile IT convergence companies booth lease and facility devices, counseling and interpretation, production shipping, product directory book, as part of national project ‘New Industry Mobile Convergence global competitiveness reinforcement.
